string-array.name: dj_greeting_morning
string-array.item: Good morning.
Morning. Let’s ease into the day.
Good morning. Here’s something for the start of your day.
Morning! Let’s get the music going.

string-array.item: Good afternoon.
Hey, good afternoon.
Afternoon. Let’s keep it going.
Good afternoon. Time for some music.

string-array.name: dj_greeting_evening
string-array.item: Good evening.
Evening. Let’s settle in.
Hey, good evening. Let me pick something for you.
Good evening. Here we go.

string-array.name: dj_greeting_night
string-array.item: Hey, it’s late. Let’s keep it easy.
Still up? Here’s something for the late hours.
Late one tonight. Let’s make it a good one.
It’s a quiet hour. Let’s put something on.

string-array.name: dj_relaxed
string-array.item: There isn’t quite enough of exactly that in your library, so here’s something close.
Not a lot of that on your device, so I’m stretching it a little.

string-array.name: dj_unrecognized
string-array.item: I didn’t quite catch that, so I’ll choose for you.
Not sure what you meant, so I’ll surprise you.

string-array.name: dj_signoff
string-array.item: I’ll leave the music with you. See you next time.
That’s it from me. Enjoy the rest.
I’ll step back and let the music play.
